parts.name: Root
parts.description: The group container. It makes a div with role="group". It controls the selection across the Toggle.Root buttons in it, and it controls the roving focus.

props.name: value
props.description:
The selected values. When you give this prop, it is the source of truth, with `bind:value` or
without it. The component writes each change here and reports it through `onChange`.

Without a binding, that write stays local. Thus a parent that hears `onChange` and refuses the
change — it sends no new `value` down — sees the group move. The group then goes back to the
value of the parent at the next render.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The selected values at the start, for when you give no `value`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it when the user changes the selection.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The number of the toggles that can be selected: one with `'single'`, or more than one with `'multiple'`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables each toggle in the group.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the layout. It sets the arrow keys that move the roving focus.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the group, usually `Toggle.Root` buttons.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the group element. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the group element.

props.name: context
props.description: A bindable reference to the internal group context, for a complex composition.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the whole group is disabled.
